### Read the Bible: Exodus 28, John 7, Proverbs 4, Galatians 3
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/exodus-28-john-7-proverbs-4-galatians-3/
Passage: Proverbs 4:23
Points:
- In biblical thought, the heart represents the entire inner person and mind rather than mere emotion.
- Guarding the heart means exercising careful vigilance over what we treasure and desire.
- What takes root internally serves as a fountain that inevitably directs all outer actions and speech.
- Prioritizing the inner life keeps external religious observance from becoming a hollow facade.
- Protecting the heart shapes practical daily habits in reading, prayer, and repentance.

### Encouragement for Today - Jan. 27, 2009
Author: Susanne Scheppmann
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-jan-27-2009-11598626.html
Passage: Proverbs 4:23
Points:
- Sin frequently slips unnoticed into the mind like a silent intruder entering a home.
- Tolerating sinful thoughts allows them to settle in and develop into destructive behavior.
- Believers are called to actively evaluate their entertainment, media consumption, and daily conversations.
- Diligently shutting the door against ungodly influences protects the heart as a source of spiritual life.

### Beginning Again - Today's Insight - May 31, 2021
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-may-31-2021.html
Passage: Proverbs 4:23-25
Points:
- Life does not offer second takes to undo harsh words, parenting mistakes, or past regrets.
- Christians should not let past guilt paralyze them when forgiveness and restoration are available.
- Today provides a new opportunity to live intentionally and make godly choices.
- Guarding the heart directly transforms speech and keeps eyes focused on an honorable path forward.

### Navigating Crossroads in Life - The Crosswalk Devotional - March 18
Author: Lynette Kittle
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/navigating-crossroads-in-life-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Proverbs 4:18
Points:
- The path of the righteous grows progressively brighter as believers walk in God's light.
- Major crossroads in life determine not only personal direction but the legacy left to future generations.
- Committing to follow Jesus brings lasting transformation that influences family culture.
- Believers do not have to navigate difficult crossroads alone because God's Word and Spirit provide guidance.
